items.title: Private Equity Wants Your Broken Garage Door. Why KKR Thinks They Are Worth $2 Billion
items.summary: KKR manages nearly $800 billion in assets, yet its next big bet is a Phoenix company that fixes broken garage doors. The logic behind a $2 billion valuation reveals something unsettling about where private equity is hunting for returns.

items.title: Blackstone’s Giant Private Credit Fund Faces More Redemptions
items.summary: Retail investors in Blackstone’s flagship private-credit fund continue to head for the exits.  Blackstone Private Credit Fund, the largest private-credit fund pitched at individual investors, received redemption requests totaling $4.3 billion in its latest quarter, accounting for about 10% of shares outstanding.  It experienced another quarter of net outflows, losing about 3% of its net asset value.

items.title: Investors Still Want Out of Private Credit Funds Like Blackstone’s and Cliffwater’s
items.summary: Blackstone and Cliffwater have seen redemption requests of about 10% and 16%, respectively, at their private credit funds.

items.title: Waymo taps into debt markets with $3B deal with Pimco, Blackstone - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- Waymo is close to securing its first debt financing, with Pacific Investment Management Co. and other lenders set to provide more than $3 billion to Alphabet Inc.'s autonomous driving unit, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.
